DRD After Movement Procedure

Step 1:   While stopped, select D | Begin recording | Wait 3-5 sec after chime |
Step 2:   Release Brake | Creep in D for 3 sec | Medium brake to a stop |  Wait for 3 sec |
Step 3:   While stopped, select R | Wait 3 sec | Release Brake and creep in R for 3 sec |
Step 4:   Medium brake to a stop | Wait for 3 sec | Shift to D and Creep forward briefly |
Step 5:   Medium brake to a stop, Immediately shift to R, and Release Brake | Creep in R briefly |
Step 6:   Medium brake to a stop , Immediately shift to D, and Release Brake | Creep in D briefly |
Step 7:   Repeat until 3 D-R-D shifts are completed | Wait 3-5 sec after last shift |
Step 8:   Save measurement using above format.

Note:  Shift directly to D or R.  If N is briefly selected, restart the test.

Engine Tests: 
| Engine Start/Stop | Idle Electric Load | Idle AC On/Off | Thr Resp.|

B2.value:
Start Stop Procedure

Step 1:   Select Park | Turn AC OFF| Turn Key to OFF | Begin recording | Wait 3-5 sec after chime | Start the Engine |
Step 2:   After Engine Start-Auto Start event, record 12x Idle Vehicle Stationary events |
Step 3:   Turn Key to OFF to stop Engine, then turn key to RUN | Wait 2-3 sec |
Step 4:   Turn Key to OFF, then immediately to START to turn the engine on |
Step 5:   Repeat this process until 4x Manual Start, 4x Manual Shut Off, and 48x Veh. Stationary events are collected.
Step 6:   Save measurement using above format.

B3.value:
AC ON/OFF Procedure

Step 1:   Select Park | Turn AC OFF |  Wait 3 secs | Begin recording |
Step 2:   Wait for 2x Idle Vehicle Stationary events | Turn AC ON |
Step 3:   Wait for 2x Idle Vehicle Stationary events | Turn  AC OFF  |
Step 4:   Repeat until 4x AC ON/OFF and 10x Vehicle Idle Stationary events are collected
Step 5:   Save measurement using above format.

B4.value:
Electric Load Procedure

Step 1:   Select Park | Turn AC and Radio OFF | Turn steering wheel to left Lock and let go | Begin recording |
Step 2:   Wait for 2x Idle Vehicle Stationary events | Turn AC ON, Radio ON, High Beams ON, and turn Steering to lock |
Step 3:   Wait for 2x Idle Vehicle Stationary events | Turn OFF AC, Radio, High Beams, and release steering wheel |
Step 4:   Repeat until 4x AC ON/OFF and 10x Vehicle Idle Stationary events are collected
Step 5:   Save measurement using above format.

B5.value:
Throttle Response Procedure

Step 1:   Set Pedal Voltage | Select Park | Turn AC OFF | Begin recording |
Step 2:   Wait for 1x Idle Vehicle Stationary events | Apply Pedal [STEP] until 3000RPM is reached |Release Pedal |
Step 3:   Wait for 1x Idle Vehicle Stationary events | Apply Pedal [STEP] until 3000RPM is reached |Release Pedal |
Step 4:   Repeat until 3x Rev Up, 3x Transition to Idle, and 4x Vehicle Idle Stationary events are collected
Step 5:   Save measurement using above format.

NOTE:  Refer to the INCA/AVL RPM signals.  The Tachometer values are delayed/filtered
             If the standing Rev Limit is below 3000RPM, use 2500RPM as the Accel Pedal release point.

Repeat the same process for 50%, 75%, and 100%.
